name: FM-1 Synth
description: Play an emulated pocket synthesizer, the M-VAVE {device}, on the board: pick one of the community's firmwares and play it by touch.

hints.fm1: The FM-1: a pocket FM synthesizer with a screen, knobs and 25 keys. Over 200 firmwares.
hints.smk37: The SMK-37: a 37-key keyboard with pads and faders, with the FM-1's chip inside. Its community ports.
